title: Steamhouse India IPO Details
intro:
Steamhouse India IPO is a book build issue of ₹414.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 4.36 crore shares aggregating to ₹353.00 crores and offer for sale of 75.31 lakh shares aggregating to ₹61.00 crores.

Steamhouse India IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 9, 2026 and will close on Sep 11, 2026. The allotment for the Steamhouse India IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 15, 2026. Steamhouse India IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 17, 2026.

Steamhouse India IPO is set issue price band at ₹77 to ₹81 per share. The lot size for an application is 185 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,985 (185 shares) (based on upper price).

Equirus Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Steamhouse India IPO RHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Steamhouse India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Steamhouse India IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Steamhouse India IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Steamhouse India IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Steamhouse India IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Steamhouse India IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Steamhouse India IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Steamhouse India IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Steamhouse India IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 16, 2026 . Check the Steamhouse India IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Steamhouse India IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Steamhouse India IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Sep 17, 2026 .
